options.name: enable_virtual_volumes
options.description: Enable the NetApp SolidFire VVols cluster feature

options.name: encryption_at_rest
options.description: enable or disable the Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) 256-bit encryption at rest on the cluster

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the SolidFire cluster. For na_elementsw_cluster, the Management IP (MIP) or hostname of the node to initiate the cluster creation from.

options.name: modify_cluster_full_threshold
options.description: The capacity level at which the cluster generates an event Requires a stage3_block_threshold_percent or max_metadata_over_provision_factor or stage2_aware_threshold

options.name: set_ntp_info
options.description: configure NTP on cluster node Requires a list of one or more ntp_servers

options.name: username
options.description: Please ensure that the user has the adequate permissions. For more information, please read the official documentation U(https://mysupport.netapp.com/documentation/docweb/index.html?productID=62636&language=en-US).
